provenance.note: implicit design assumption, never contemporaneously tested

H-BUS-STALE-PRECEDENCE:interp:1.rationale: assumed correct by design before user reproduction
H-BUS-STALE-PRECEDENCE:interp:1.statement: Dependency-version invalidation precedes intrinsic derived status in effective_status

H-BUS-STALE-PRECEDENCE:interp:2.rationale: user reproduction showed ambiguous persisted post-change; refutation is of the implementation, conditioned on the pre-fix bus code
H-BUS-STALE-PRECEDENCE:interp:2.statement: Refuted as implemented: intrinsic ambiguous outranked dependency invalidation; the old tie was presented as current after Q3's cost changed

H-BUS-STALE-PRECEDENCE:interp:3.rationale: targeted bus tests and full EPI-05 substrate tests pass post-fix
H-BUS-STALE-PRECEDENCE:interp:3.statement: Supported as of efc14c0: dependency-version checking precedes intrinsic status; regression test covers ambiguous -> stale -> resolved Q1

H-EPI05-BINDING:interp:1.rationale: BOUND_INVOKE preservation 18/18; AUTO_DISPATCH 18/18 with zero neural tokens
H-EPI05-BINDING:interp:1.statement: Structural binding preserves mechanical results exactly; retranscription is the fragile boundary

H-EPI05-M02:interp:1.rationale: m02 recorded trace: C:0/1 emitted for correct H1/H2 order 1/0; comparator returned unique=C because inequality is reversal-symmetric; fresh readout answered none
H-EPI05-M02:interp:1.statement: Neural retranscription copies operand order from display rather than structure; comparator symmetry can mask the reversal while downstream readout still fails

H-EPI06-CONTRACT-REPAIR:interp:1.rationale: preregistered threshold: >=15/18 strict non-normal plus stale correct
H-EPI06-CONTRACT-REPAIR:interp:1.statement: Non-normal readout failures are output-contract failures repairable by explicit few-shot contract examples (H1)

H-EPI06-CONTRACT-REPAIR:interp:2.rationale: all seven residual failures emitted target=none; refutation conditioned on this contract-repair formulation and model
H-EPI06-CONTRACT-REPAIR:interp:2.statement: H1 fails the binding threshold: 11/18 < 15/18 despite format validity 37/37 and resolved 18/18. Contract repair has a large real effect but is insufficient. Residual failure is specific: incomplete/unknown evidence collapses to the negative completed result 'none' — an epistemic distinction failure, not a format failure

H-EPI06-MECH-RENDER:interp:1.rationale: matrix 37/37 + epistemic 12/12 fidelity, ties 2/2, 2 generations / 14 tokens, zero stale-value emissions after metric correction
H-EPI06-MECH-RENDER:interp:1.statement: Deterministic rendering of mechanical facts with neural generation confined to genuinely unresolved tie selection executes the battery faithfully at minimal neural cost

H-EPI06-POLICY-BOUNDARY:interp:1.rationale: consistent_nodisc expected insufficient_evidence, observed abstain (0/2); resolved controls correctly abstained (4/4) — same token, opposite correctness; mechanical policy replay matches all 49 expected actions without a model call
H-EPI06-POLICY-BOUNDARY:interp:1.statement: The neural layer collapses mechanically distinct action semantics — none vs unknown, insufficient_evidence vs abstain — while the typed state itself carries the distinction perfectly (mechanical replay 49/49 on the same inputs)

H-G05-COHERENT-LETHAL:interp:1.rationale: L0 conv1d k=0.25 additive drives ppl 11.4 -> 1315; collapse is quality not numeric
H-G05-COHERENT-LETHAL:interp:1.statement: Coherent dense edits at the input boundary cause quality collapse at low magnitude

H-G05-DEPTH-GRADIENT:interp:1.rationale: collapse threshold rises 0.25 -> 2 -> 4 -> never across depth
H-G05-DEPTH-GRADIENT:interp:1.statement: Coherent-edit fragility decays steeply with depth; layer 0 is uniquely catastrophic

H-G05-SAFE-NULL:interp:1.rationale: safety evidence is strong but leverage evidence does not exist yet; the taxonomy document itself flags this as the real Gate 1 risk
H-G05-SAFE-NULL:interp:1.statement: The provably safe edit surface (sparse scalar, mid/late layers) may be disjoint from the effective edit surface — constraints may land in safe-but-null territory

provenance.note: Phase A closing hypothesis, documented before Phase B ran

H-G05-SELFEDIT-MECHANISM:interp:1.rationale: fragility surface shows coherent early edits are lethal; a goal-directed editor can select exactly the lethal direction
H-G05-SELFEDIT-MECHANISM:interp:1.statement: The source paper's '4B broke itself' collapse was caused by the self-editor selecting coherent additive edits; Phase B will confirm coherent-edit selection

H-G05-SELFEDIT-MECHANISM:interp:2.rationale: documented Phase B outcome contradicts the documented Phase A expectation; rejection conditioned on this proposer scaffolding and budget
H-G05-SELFEDIT-MECHANISM:interp:2.statement: The self-editor did NOT select coherent additive edits: all 6 runs survived via attenuation-only selections. The Phase A selection hypothesis is refuted as stated; the paper's collapse mechanism remains unexplained (possibly scaffolding or batch effects). The underlying fragility findings are unaffected — the editor simply never went there.

H-G05-SPARSE-SAFE:interp:1.rationale: 0/136 collapses across the sparse scalar sweep; negligible L2 when scattered
H-G05-SPARSE-SAFE:interp:1.statement: Sparse scalar edits (<=512 scalars, bounded magnitude) do not collapse the model

H-G12-CORRESPONDENCE:interp:1.rationale: cleanest mechanistic finding of the gate1_2 campaign
H-G12-CORRESPONDENCE:interp:1.statement: Observation-channel value is determined by correspondence between feedback content and the intervention it informs

H-G12-SHARED-PARENT:interp:1.rationale: observation-layer spec rule: catalog records obs_group so identical values are not mistaken for independent evidence
H-G12-SHARED-PARENT:interp:1.statement: Parameters sharing a hooked parent module yield identical observations; treating them as independent evidence is a measurement confound
